detector.description: Alerts when there are no active controllers in a cluster, there is only 1 broker set as an active controller per cluster
detector.name: Kafka - No Active Controller
detector.programText:
A = data('gauge.kafka-active-controllers').sum(by=['cluster']).publish(label='A')
detect(when(A < threshold(1)), auto_resolve_after='1d').publish('Kafka - No Active Controller')

rules.description: The value of Active Controllers is below 1.
